  "memo":"R03 holds: the BR-issued card was used from a US IP and AVS failed. Card is the sole adverse family; no other rule holds, no household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Longstanding device and card use plus home delivery favor a legitimate-customer explanation but do not resolve authorization. With no completed checks, recommend needs_check under §6.6(b), implemented as a hold for issuer authentication and identity verification. A decline is not permitted on this single-family evidence. The order has not shipped; a passed required id_check would clear it."
